name: Reflection AI
description: Reflection AI is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Reflection AI is a privately held artificial intelligence company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent announced financing, a $2 billion round disclosed on October 9, 2025, valued the company at $8 billion.

Reflection AI develops large language models and publishes their weights for others to use, beginning with Beam, an open-weight model it introduced in October 2026. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Reflection AI
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round; the Series A valuation is as reported by Bloomberg. Reflection AI announced its October 2025 round without a series designation, and it disclosed its seed and Series A rounds together in March 2025.
round_notes: Nvidia led the October 2025 round. In March 2026, Reuters, citing The Wall Street Journal, reported that Reflection AI was in talks to raise $2.5 billion at a valuation of $25 billion. Reflection AI has not announced a further round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Nvidia led the October 2025 round, in which Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, 1789 Capital, B Capital, GIC and Citi also invested. Lightspeed Venture Partners and CRV co-led the Series A, and Sequoia Capital and CRV led the seed round. Other investors include Disruptive, Eric Schmidt and Zoom founder Eric Yuan.
spv_sentence: Since 2025, four special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Reflection AI have filed with the SEC, three of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Reflection AI's funding announcement (2025) and Beam announcement (October 5, 2026); reports by Bloomberg (March 2025), TechCrunch (October 2025), SiliconANGLE (October 2025 and March 2025) and Reuters (March 2026); reports by The Wall Street Journal; and SEC Form D filings.
